# has-ansi [![Build Status](https://example.invalid/sindresorhus/has-ansi.svg?branch=master)](https://example.invalid/sindresorhus/has-ansi)

> Check if a string has [ANSI escape codes](http://example.invalid/wiki/ANSI_escape_code)


## Install

```
$ npm install --save has-ansi
```


## Usage

```js
var hasAnsi = require('has-ansi');

hasAnsi('\u001b[4mcake\u001b[0m');
//=> true

hasAnsi('cake');
//=> false
```
